ns2:section.sectionText: For Fall 2021, Sections AL1, AL2, ALP, and ALR will alternate having half of students meet in classroom space and the other half meeting synchronously online on Tuesdays. Which students meet in classroom space and synchronously online will be swapped on Thursdays. This section does not have a separate lab. This section is restricted to DGS prep and Engineering Undeclared. It will NOT open to CS, general campus, or any group other than DGS PREP and Engineering Undeclared. There are NO exceptions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Undeclared or Pre-Engineering major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
